title: Shell history file served from the web root
description: The response is a shell history: command lines that include directory changes and the operational tools the host runs. History files record the commands an administrator typed, including the ones that carried a token on the command line.
remediation: Keep history files out of the document root, and pass secrets through a file descriptor or an environment variable rather than an argument.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the history shape; a single line of text is not reported.

observation.body:
cd /var/www/shop
sudo systemctl restart nginx
kubectl get pods -n shop

cd /srv
mysqldump -h db.internal -u app shop > dump.sql
curl -s http://cache.internal:6379/ping
Run the commands in order and restart the service afterwards.
Run the migrations before restarting the service.
